name: Midges & phantom midges (Diptera larvae)
description: Aquatic larvae of two-winged flies, the most diverse animal group in the lake. Functional group pooling the source's 31 Diptera taxa - mostly detritus- and algae-eating chironomid midges (Chironomus, Polypedilum, Tanytarsus and kin), plus the predatory tanypods (Procladius) and the glass-like phantom midge larvae Chaoborus, which hunt small zooplankton. Pooling predators and grazers here follows the source's own Diptera grouping.
